method: OLS log ratios; Bartlett Newey-West lag3, n/(n-p) covariance correction and t(df=25) intervals; lags1/6 and February break sensitivity
interpretation: Percent difference in the fitted ratio relative to projected pre-break ratio trend. This is not a significance test comparing frozen separate-outcome GLS terminal percentages. Short-series uncertainty remains. Exponentiated fitted logs describe geometric ratios.
